name: finvault
description: Banking simulator for UI/API test practice (1000+ UI, 500+ API scenarios)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finvault/api" "npm run dev -w @finvault/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @finvault/api && npm run build -w @finvault/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @finvault/shared && npm run db:seed -w @finvault/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run build -w @finvault/shared && npm run db:reset -w @finvault/api
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
